title: Data Engineer
description: Job Requirements As a Data Engineer in IPB 3.0, you will design, build and operate scalable data solutions that transform data from multiple sources into trusted, analytics-ready products. You will work across Snowflake, cloud-based data integration and Power BI, while actively exploring AI-enabled capabilities and continuously learning emerging technologies. What Are My Responsibilities? Design, develop and maintain reliable data pipelines using Azure Data Factory or a comparable enterprise ETL/ELT and orchestration platform. Build scalable data ingestion, transformation and data-processing solutions on Snowflake for structured and semi-structured data. Develop reusable SQL transformations, data models and curated datasets that support reporting, analytics and AI use cases. Collaborate with data architects, analysts, Power BI developers, product stakeholders and source-system teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Enable Power BI consumption by delivering well-structured semantic-ready datasets, applying sound dimensional modelling and supporting performance optimization. Implement data quality checks, monitoring, logging, alerting and operational controls to improve reliability and traceability. Contribute to CI/CD, version control, automated deployment and DataOps practices for data pipelines and Snowflake objects. Troubleshoot pipeline failures, data discrepancies and performance bottlenecks across the end-to-end data flow. Create prototypes and proof of concepts for AI-driven data solutions, including opportunities that use Snowflake Cortex AI capabilities. Stay curious about new technologies, evaluate their relevance to IPB 3.0, share knowledge with the team and convert promising ideas into practical outcomes. Qualification and Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science or an equivalent discipline. Approximately 4-6 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, data warehousing, ETL/ELT and relational database technologies. Proven experience delivering production-grade data pipelines and cloud data solutions in an enterprise environment. Experience working with globally distributed technical and business stakeholders is preferred. Required Technical Knowledge and Experience Strong hands-on expertise in Snowflake, including SQL development, data loading, transformations, performance-aware design and role-based access concepts. Strong experience with Azure Data Factory or a similar ETL/ELT tool for pipeline development, orchestration, scheduling, dependency management and monitoring. Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modelling, star and snowflake schemas, data marts and data integration patterns. Good SQL skills and experience working with large-volume datasets from heterogeneous source systems. Working knowledge of Power BI, including how data models, refresh patterns and curated datasets influence reporting performance and usability. Experience with source control and CI/CD practices, preferably using Git and an enterprise deployment platform. Understanding of data quality, metadata, lineage, security, governance and production support practices. Working knowledge of Python or another scripting language is desirable. Added Advantage Knowledge of Snowflake Cortex AI, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, Snowflake ML functions or other native AI capabilities in Snowflake. Experience building or supporting AI/ML, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation or intelligent analytics use cases. Exposure to Azure services such as Azure Blob Storage, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Functions, Azure Key Vault or Azure Databricks. Experience with APIs, event-driven ingestion, semi-structured data and modern data-sharing patterns. Familiarity with Power BI semantic models, DAX, dataflows or deployment pipelines. Required Soft Skills and Other Capabilities Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with attention to data accuracy and technical detail. Curiosity and a clear inclination toward AI, experimentation and continuous learning of new technologies. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a global, cross-functional team. Good planning, prioritization and ownership of deliverables from design through production support. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical topics to both technical and business stakeholders. Collaborative approach to sharing ideas, reviewing solutions and improving team engineering practices. Candidate Profile: A hands-on data engineer who combines strong platform fundamentals with curiosity, ownership and enthusiasm for building the next generation of AI-enabled data products for Siemens Healthineers CES team.

title: Data Engineer
description: "Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Databricks Data Engineer to design and enhance enterprise document-processing and data-extraction solutions. The role will focus on ingesting structured and unstructured content, extracting business and policy information using LLM-based approaches, improving extraction accuracy, and making validated information available to downstream applications through an ontology-driven data layer. The engineer will join a small, hands-on team working on document intelligence solutions supporting brokerage and underwriting workflows. A major focus will be redesigning existing pipelines to improve accuracy, performance, scalability, and maintainability while supporting a broader migration from Microsoft Fabric to Databricks. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and optimize Databricks data pipelines for document ingestion, classification, extraction, validation, and downstream consumption. Process information from multiple document and communication formats, including: o PDF documents o Emails and attachments o Excel/XLSX files o Insurance applications o Statements of Values (SOVs) o Other structured and unstructured documents Improve existing extraction pipelines where LLMs produce false positives, incorrect metadata, or inaccurate field values. Develop validation and quality-control approaches that improve the reliability of extracted information. Implement document classification and content-aware extraction strategies. Handle source-specific extraction rules, such as extracting particular attributes from an email rather than from attached documents. Design pipelines that transform extracted information into consistent, structured JSON outputs for downstream applications. Contribute to the design and implementation of a custom ontology layer that represents key insurance business entities and relationships. Map extracted information into the ontology so applications can consume standardized business concepts rather than raw document fields. Address performance challenges associated with processing large or complex Excel/XLSX and SOV files. Optimize pipeline scalability and concurrency for production workloads. Work with PostgreSQL/Lakebase-based persistence for final structured outputs. Collaborate closely with brokerage, underwriting, AI, and data engineering teams to connect extracted application data with downstream underwriting processes. Required Qualifications Strong hands-on experience with Databricks and production data engineering. Strong proficiency in Python, PySpark, and SQL. Experience building scalable ingestion and transformation pipelines on the Databricks platform. Experience processing unstructured and semi-structured data, particularly PDFs, emails, Excel files, JSON, and business documents. Experience integrating LLMs or AI models into data-processing pipelines. Understanding of prompt-based and structured data extraction from documents. Experience implementing data validation, reconciliation, or quality controls for AI-generated outputs. Strong understanding of data modeling, metadata, schemas, entity relationships, and semantic/ontology concepts. Experience designing APIs, JSON structures, or data products for downstream application consumption. Experience troubleshooting performance, scalability, and concurrency issues in production data pipelines. Experience working with cloud-based data architectures. Minimum 7+ years of experience in data engineering, software development, or production data pipeline development. Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience with Databricks and scalable data-processing pipelines."
